comments.text: I visited Riyadh in the late 90s, and the contrast to today is stark. However, the integration of women into engineering, medicine, and corporate leadership isn't just a social reform it is a strict economic necessity. You cannot successfully diversify a modern economy while keeping half of your educated population out of the workforce.
